items.title: AddLife buys MoonSurge, a Portuguese distributor of advanced surgery devices
items.summary: AddLife announced on 03/11/2026 that it has acquired MoonSurge, a Portuguese distributor of medical devices for advanced surgery, with about EUR 5 million annual revenue and 14 employees.

items.title: Medtech earnings: slower surgery volumes weigh on some device makers
items.summary: MedTech Dive reports that Johnson & Johnson, Boston Scientific, Intuitive and Stryker cited lower procedure volumes as a drag on some device growth in the third quarter.

items.title: Zimmer submits Monogram autonomous orthopaedic robot to FDA
items.summary: Zimmer Biomet has filed a 510(k) for the Monogram autonomous orthopaedic robot, which uses CT imaging unlike its existing Rosa system. The company is targeting FDA clearance and a 2027 launch, a year ahead of its earlier 2028 plan. Zimmer bought Monogram in 2025 for $177 million.

items.title: MMI launches Nanowrist monopolar scissors for Symani robotic microsurgery system
items.summary: MMI has launched a new instrument for its Symani robotic microsurgery system. The company won a CE mark for the scissors last month and is seeking FDA 510(k) clearance. Article page is bot-blocked; date taken from the newsletter.

items.title: J&J to install first Ottava robot in US hospital
items.summary: Memorial Hermann-Texas Medical Center will be the first US hospital to install Johnson & Johnson's Ottava soft tissue surgical robot, whose four arms are built into a standard operating table.

items.title: Three more elective surgical hubs in England earn national accreditation
items.summary: GIRFT reports that three more elective surgical hubs in England have earned national accreditation under the hub accreditation scheme.

items.title: FDA clears Masimo's smartSedLine brain function monitor
items.summary: FDA has cleared Masimo's smartSedLine EEG-based brain monitoring system, which computes a Patient State Index to aid anaesthesia, with an updated algorithm aimed at elderly and high-risk surgical patients. Works with Masimo Root and O3 Regional Oximetry.

items.title: FDA clears Medtronic's Hugo robot for general surgery
items.summary: FDA has cleared Medtronic's Hugo robotic-assisted system for upper abdominal general surgery (e.g. small bowel resection, cholecystectomy, ventral hernia repair) plus appendectomy and inguinal hernia repair, beyond its prior urology indications.

items.title: STERIS to acquire Xodus Medical (Pink Pad patient positioning) for $2.1bn; $1.5bn notes priced to fund it
items.summary: STERIS Corporation agreed on 11/10/2026 to buy Xodus Medical, Inc., a Pennsylvania specialty surgical products business focused on patient and operating room staff safety, for $2.1bn in cash at closing plus up to $150m earnout on calendar-2028 targets (8-K filed 13/10/2026; 10-Q note 17).

items.title: STERIS starts a second restructuring plan: Healthcare facility realignment and product rationalisation
items.summary: STERIS's 10-Q for the quarter to 30/09/2026 (filed with its results on 04/11/2026) records a Fiscal 2027 Portfolio and Organizational Optimization Plan, approved in that quarter and mainly in the Healthcare segment: targeted facility realignment, product rationalisation and organisational…

items.title: Mölnlycke names Anders Andersson CEO and Fredrik Wallefors President of Surgical from 01/01/2027
items.summary: Anders Andersson, Executive Vice President of Wound Care, becomes CEO of Mölnlycke Health Care, and Fredrik Wallefors, Executive Vice President of Operating Room Solutions, becomes President of Surgical, both on 01/01/2027. Guillaume Joucla stays interim CEO until the end of 2026.
